```{r}
#| include: false
source("setup.R")
```

Browse and search the full Palmer Penguins dataset. Use the filters and search box to explore.

<center>

<div style="width:900px">

```{r}
penguins_clean |>
  select(
    Species = species,
    Island = island,
    `Bill Length (mm)` = bill_length_mm,
    `Bill Depth (mm)` = bill_depth_mm,
    `Flipper Length (mm)` = flipper_length_mm,
    `Body Mass (g)` = body_mass_g,
    Sex = sex,
    Year = year
  ) |>
  reactable::reactable(
    searchable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 15,
    showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
    pageSizeOptions = c(5, 10, 15, 25, 50)
  )
```

</div>
